name: Dangote Petroleum Refinery and Petrochemicals FZE
unit: NGN, printed in millions (N millions) and stored absolute (x1000000 = whole Naira)
scale_note: The prospectus states the Naira statements in 'million; multiplied by 1000000 here, the whole-currency unit the other statement files in this tree use. The same statements are also printed in US$ '000 in the prospectus (pages 75 to 76); the Naira columns are used to match the NGX convention.
listing_status: Not listed. SEC-approved offer for subscription open 14 September to 13 October 2026; listing on the NGX Main Board indicated for late November to early December 2026 and NOT fixed. There is no traded price and no market capitalisation: N525.00 is a SUBSCRIPTION price. The prospectus's own indicative market capitalisation at listing (N65,220,180,848,025, page 35 item 17) is an offer-implied figure, not a traded value, and is not carried in these statement files.
source: Dangote Petroleum Refinery and Petrochemicals FZE, Initial Public Offering Prospectus dated 07 September 2026 (SEC Nigeria cleared), Historical Financial Information, Statement of Financial Position page 75 and Statement of Profit or Loss and Other Comprehensive Income page 76, both printed in Naira 'million and US$ '000; period tables cross-checked at Operating and Financial Review pages 86 to 91; indebtedness at pages 38 and 159. Audited by Deloitte & Touche; reporting accountant KPMG Professional Services. H1 2026 is the six months ended 30 June 2026; FY2025 to FY2021 are the years ended 31 December. Values stored as absolute Naira (printed 'million x 1000000). This is the Nigerian refinery alone: not Dangote Cement Plc, nor the announced, unbuilt Lamu project.

rows.label: Revenue
rows.note: Printed: H1 2026 19,134,942; FY2025 18,737,977; FY2024 9,380,990. FY2023 to FY2021 are nil: the issuer was in its pre-operational/construction phase and earned no revenue (pages 86 and 90).

rows.label: Cost of Sales
rows.note: Printed in brackets (a charge); stored negative, as printed.

rows.label: Other Income
rows.note: Not a panel row. Gain on sale of scrap, gain on disposal of property, plant and equipment, and insurance claims settlements (page 84).

rows.label: Other Gains/(Losses)
rows.source: page 76; labelled Foreign exchange gains/(losses) at page 86
rows.note: Not a panel row. Foreign exchange gains/(losses) on Naira-denominated monetary items. The FY2023 gain of 377,898 is what turned that pre-operational year into a reported profit (page 90).

rows.label: Impairment Charge On Expected Credit Loss
rows.note: Not a panel row. Stored negative as printed.

rows.label: Administrative Expenses (filed)
rows.note: Not a panel row, and NOT the whole of the difference between gross and operating profit: other income and foreign exchange gains sit between them. The prospectus prints no single operating-expenses total, so the panel's Operating Expenses row is left blank rather than filled with this line alone.

rows.label: Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.note: As printed. The page 86 period table rounds the FY2024 operating loss to (940,874); the audited summary figure (940,873) is stored.

rows.label: Finance Income
rows.note: Not a panel row. Interest income on Naira fixed deposits placed with commercial banks; no related-party income (page 85).

rows.label: Finance Costs
rows.note: Not a panel row. Stored negative as printed.

rows.label: Profit Before Tax
rows.note: FY2024 is the first year of commercial operation and carried a loss of 2,233,179. FY2023's 289,359 profit is a pre-operational foreign exchange gain, not an operating result.

rows.label: Income Tax
rows.note: H1 2026 only: minimum effective tax rate top-up tax, development levy and deferred tax (page 88). Nil in every other period under the free zone tax status. The page 85 free-zone exemption table is a hypothetical tax charge, not the filed expense, and is not carried here.

rows.label: Net Profit
rows.note: The prospectus's Profit/(loss) for the period/year. Profit Before Tax plus Income Tax equals this on every column.

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.derivedFrom: Operating Profit (EBIT) - Gross Profit: the net amount that bridges gross profit to operating profit. It is NEGATIVE here because other income and foreign exchange gains exceed administrative expenses and the impairment charge. The prospectus prints no operating-expenses total, so this is arithmetic on filed figures, not a reported figure. Blank for FY2023 to FY2021, which are pre-operational years with nil gross profit.

rows.label: Debt to Equity
rows.derivedFrom: Total Liabilities / Total Equity. High in FY2022 to FY2024 because equity was thin against the construction debt; falls to 0.98x at 30 June 2026 as the private placement and the first profitable half rebuild equity.

identityChecks: Revenue + Cost of Sales = Gross Profit
Gross Profit + Other Income + Other Gains/(Losses) + Impairment Charge + Administrative Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT)
Operating Profit (EBIT) + Net Finance Costs = Profit Before Tax
Profit Before Tax + Income Tax = Net Profit
reconciliation_note: Every column ties on the printed figures. H1 2026 is a HALF YEAR (six months to 30 June 2026) and must not be read at a full-year scale: it is the period in which the Refinery moved to full-capacity production from March 2026. FY2024 is the first year of commercial operation; FY2023 to FY2021 are pre-operational or construction years with nil revenue. No EBITDA figure is printed anywhere in the prospectus: it defines EBITDA (page 16) and states a Net Debt-to-EBITDA ratio of 0.27x at 30 June 2026 (page 138), but prints no EBITDA amount, so none is carried. No earnings per share is printed, so the panel's EPS row is left blank. Source: prospectus dated 07 September 2026, pages 75, 76 and 86 to 91.
periodOrder: newest first: the interim H1 2026 column (six months) precedes the audited full years FY2025 to FY2021, and every value stays on its own period label.
